name: Dailymotion

disclosure.zh: Dailymotion：标题必填（≤ 255），描述 ≤ 3000，描述里最多 15 个 #话题。分类、语言、是否面向儿童由你选。AI 生成内容请在描述里说明。
disclosure.en: Dailymotion: title required (<= 255), description <= 3,000 with up to 15 #hashtags. Category, language and made-for-kids are yours to pick. Say in the description when the video is AI-made.

guide.zh: 打开 Studio → 媒体 → 上传视频，应用放入视频、填好标题和描述。选分类、语言、是否面向儿童和可见范围，再由你点「发布」。
guide.en: Open Studio → Media → Upload video; the app adds the video and types the title and description. Pick category, language, made-for-kids and visibility, then press Publish yourself.

notes: UNVERIFIED selectors (written 2026-10 without a logged-in session): check them on the live page, then set status to verified + lastVerified.
The current Studio host is unverified (older: dailymotion.com/partner/); check the address bar after signing in and override uploadUrl locally.
Standard accounts: 2 h / 4 GB per video, 15 uploads per 24 h.
